title: MotionDeblur IC-LoRA for LTX-2.3 Video Restoration
summary: A specialized In-Context LoRA (IC-LoRA) for the Lightricks LTX-2.3 (22B) model designed to remove motion blur and per-frame smearing. It functions as a video-to-video restoration tool, reconstructing sharp frames using the blurred source as conditioning.
research_notes: Requires the specialized LTXICLoRALoaderModelOnly node for implementation within ComfyUI pipelines.

evolution.summary: Expanded into a comprehensive Video Restoration Suite for LTX-2.3, including ReFocus (lens blur), Deinterlace, and Uncompress tools. The project is now central to the LTX Collaborations organization, providing professional-grade restoration workflows.
